sections.title: باب 2 — متن (16)

paras.text: … thing is not. Islam has fixed a share for women in inheritance. In Islam women have been given several social rights as daughter, wife, mother and sister. Before Islam girls used to be buried alive immediately after birth, but Islam prohibited it. In the blessed Hadith it is mentioned that “whoever brings up two daughters, looks after them well and brings them up with love and affection, he will enter Paradise.” Islam has provided women economic and social protection. In the same way the right of protection from slander is also given to women. According to verse number 4 of Surah An-Nur, “Those who accuse chaste women of adultery and then do not bring four witnesses, lash them eighty lashes and never accept their testimony; these are the transgressors.” Legally women have the right, after marriage, to attach the name of the father or husband to their own name.
paras.urdu: بات نہیں۔ اِسلام نے خواتین کیلئے وراثت میں حصہ مقرر کیا ہوا ہے۔ اِسلام میں خواتین کے بطورِ بیٹی، بیوی، ماں اور بہن کے کئی معاشرتی حقوق مقرر کئے ہیں۔ اِسلام سے پہلے لڑکیوں کو پیدائش کے فوراً بعد زندہ دفن کیا جاتا تھا لیکن اِسلام نے اِس کو منع کیا۔ حدیثِ پاک میں ذکر ہے کہ ’’کوئی شخص بھی دو بیٹیوں کو پالتا ہے اُن کی اچھی طرح دیکھ بھال کرتا ہے اور محبت و شفقت سے اُن کی پرورش کرتا ہے وہ جنت میں داخل ہوگا‘‘۔ اِسلام نے خواتین کو معاشی اور سماجی تحفظ فراہم کیا ہے۔ اِس طرح تہمت لگنے سے تحفظ کا حق بھی عورت کو حاصل ہے۔ سورۃ النور آیت نمبر 4 کے مطابق ’’جو لوگ پاک دامن عورتوں پر زنا کاری کی تہمت لگائیں پھر چار گواہ پیش نہ کر سکیں تو انہیں اسی کوڑے لگاؤ اور کبھی بھی اُن کی گواہی قبول نہ کرو۔ یہ فاسق لوگ ہیں‘‘۔ قانونی طور پر خواتین کو شادی کے بعد اپنے نام کے ساتھ باپ یا شوہر کے نام لگانے کا حق حاصل ہے۔
paras.pashto: … خبره نه ده. اسلام د ښځو لپاره په میراث کې برخه ټاکلې. په اسلام کې ښځو ته د لور، مېرمنې، مور او خور په توګه څو ټولنیز حقونه ټاکل شوي. له اسلام مخکې نجونې له زېږون سمدستي وروسته ژوندۍ ښخېدې، خو اسلام دا منع کړ. په مبارک حدیث کې یادونه ده چې "څوک دوه لوڼې روزي، ښه پاملرنه یې کوي او په مینه او شفقت یې روزي، جنت ته به ننوځي." اسلام ښځو ته اقتصادي او ټولنیزه ساتنه برابره کړې. همداراز ښځې ته له تور لګولو د ساتنې حق هم ورکړل شوی. د سورة النور د ۴م آیت له مخې "هغه کسان چې پر پاکلمنو ښځو د زنا تور لګوي او بیا څلور شاهدان نه شي راوستی، اتیا دورې یې ووهئ او هېڅکله یې شاهدي مه منئ؛ دا فاسقان دي." په قانوني ډول ښځو ته حق دی چې له واده وروسته د خپل نوم سره د پلار یا مېړه نوم یوځای کړي.

paras.text: Article 10 of the convention provides men and women equal opportunities in every field for the acquisition of education. In the same way equal opportunities of physical education and sports will be given. In Islam the importance of and right to education for women is clear from this fact that Hazrat Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) was a famous student; according to Urwah bin Zubair he did not see a greater scholar than Hazrat Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) in Arab history in understanding the Quran, following the commandments, observing the law, literature, poetry and history. She also had knowledge of medicine and was an expert in law and inheritance too. She taught 88 scholars and is the narrator of 2219 ahadith. Proof of the scholarship of Hazrat Safiyyah (may Allah be pleased with her), Hazrat Umm Salamah (may Allah be pleased with her) and Hazrat Umm Sulaim (may Allah be pleased with her) also exists. The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) said that acquiring knowledge is obligatory on every Muslim man and woman. From this it is proved that acquiring education is the right of both men and women.
paras.urdu: کنونشن کا دفعہ 10 مرد و خواتین کو حصولِ تعلیم کیلئے ہر میدان میں مساوی مواقع فراہم کرتا ہے۔ اِس طرح جسمانی تعلیم اور کھیل کود کے مساوی مواقع دیئے جائیں گے۔ اِسلام میں خواتین کیلئے تعلیم کی اہمیت اور حق اِس حقیقت سے واضح ہے کہ حضرت عائشہؓ کی ایک مشہور طالبہ اور عروہ بن زبیر کے مطابق آپ نے قرآن فہمی، احکامات کی پیروی، قانون کی پابندی، ادب، شاعری اور تاریخ عرب میں حضرت عائشہؓ سے بڑا سکالر کوئی نہیں دیکھا۔ آپؓ طب کا علم بھی رکھتی تھیں اور قانونِ وراثت میں بھی ماہر تھیں۔ آپؓ نے 88 علماء کو پڑھایا اور 2219 احادیث کی راوی ہیں۔ حضرت صفیہؓ، حضرت اُمِ سلمہؓ اور حضرت اُمِ سلیمؓ کی علمیت کے بارے میں بھی ثبوت موجود ہیں۔ آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وعلیٰ آلہ واصحابہ وسلم نے فرمایا کہ علم حاصل کرنا مسلمان مرد و عورت پر فرض ہے۔ اِس سے ثابت ہے کہ تعلیم حاصل کرنا مرد و زن دونوں کا حق ہے۔
paras.pashto: د کنوانسیون ۱۰مه ماده نارینه او ښځو ته د زده‌کړې د ترلاسه کولو لپاره په هره برخه کې برابر فرصتونه برابروي. همداراز د بدني زده‌کړې او لوبو برابر فرصتونه به ورکول کېږي. په اسلام کې د ښځو لپاره د زده‌کړې اهمیت او حق له دې حقیقت روښانه دی چې حضرت عایشه (رض) یوه مشهوره زده‌کوونکې وه او د عروه بن زبیر په وینا هغه په قرآن پوهنه، د احکامو په پیروۍ، د قانون په پابندۍ، ادب، شاعرۍ او د عربو په تاریخ کې له حضرت عایشې (رض) لوی پوه نه دی لیدلی. هغې د طب علم هم درلود او د میراث په قانون کې هم ماهره وه. هغې ۸۸ علماوو ته درس ورکړ او د ۲۲۱۹ احادیثو راوي ده. د حضرت صفیې (رض)، حضرت ام سلمې (رض) او حضرت ام سلیم (رض) د علمیت په اړه هم ثبوت شته. رسول الله (صلی الله علیه وعلی آله واصحابه وسلم) وفرمایل چې د علم زده‌کړه پر هر مسلمان نارینه او ښځه فرض ده. له دې ثابتېږي چې د زده‌کړې ترلاسه کول د نارینه او ښځو دواړو حق دی.

paras.text: According to Article 11, party states will provide women equal opportunities of adopting the employment and profession of their own choice. In this respect no discrimination will be allowed against women. During pregnancy they will not be compelled to do any dangerous work, and in this respect women will have complete legal protection. In Islam women will be permitted to adopt employment provided it is within the sphere of the Shariah. In the Quran and Hadith there is no such mention that a woman should not be employed. If she herself does not feel the need, women cannot be compelled to adopt employment. The husband has not been bound to take anything from the wife’s lawful earnings. Whatever the woman earns during employment is her own income, and she cannot be compelled to spend it in the house …
paras.urdu: دفعہ 11 کے مطابق فریق ریاستیں خواتین کو اپنی مرضی کی ملازمت و پیشہ اختیار کرنے کے مساوی مواقع فراہم کرے گی۔ اِس حوالے سے خواتین کے ساتھ کوئی اِمتیاز روا نہیں رکھا جائے گا۔ دورانِ حمل اُن کو خطرناک کام کرنے پر مجبور نہیں کیا جائے گا اور اِس حوالے سے خواتین کو مکمل قانونی تحفظ حاصل ہوگا۔ اِسلام میں خواتین کو ملازمت اختیار کرنے کی اجازت ہے بشرطیکہ شریعت کے دائرہ کے اندر ہو۔ قرآن و احادیث میں ایسا کوئی ذکر نہیں کہ عورت ملازمت نہ کرے۔ اگر خود ضرورت محسوس نہ کرے تو خواتین کو ملازمت اختیار کرنے پر مجبور نہیں کیا جا سکتا۔ شوہر کو تو بیوی کی حلال کمائی میں سے کچھ نہ لینے کا پابند بھی بنایا گیا ہے۔ عورت ملازمت کے دوران جو کماتی ہے وہ اُس کی اپنی آمدن ہے اور اُسے گھر …
paras.pashto: د ۱۱مې مادې له مخې غړي دولتونه به ښځو ته د خپلې خوښې دندې او مسلک د غوره کولو برابر فرصتونه برابروي. په دې اړه به له ښځو سره هېڅ تبعیض نه کېږي. د امیندوارۍ پر مهال به خطرناک کار ته اړ نه کېږي او په دې اړه به ښځو ته بشپړ قانوني ساتنه حاصله وي. په اسلام کې ښځو ته د دندې د غوره کولو اجازه ده په دې شرط چې د شریعت په دایره کې وي. په قرآن او احادیثو کې داسې یادونه نشته چې ښځه دې دنده ونه کړي. که پخپله اړتیا احساس نه کړي، ښځې د دندې په غوره کولو نه شي اړ کېدای. مېړه خو پابند شوی چې د مېرمنې له حلالې ګټې څه وانخلي. ښځه چې د دندې پر مهال څه ګټي، هغه د هغې خپل عاید دی او په کور کې …

… thing is not. Islam has fixed a share for women in inheritance. In Islam women have been given several social rights as daughter, wife, mother and sister. Before Islam girls used to be buried alive immediately after birth, but Islam prohibited it. In the blessed Hadith it is mentioned that “whoever brings up two daughters, looks after them well and brings them up with love and affection, he will enter Paradise.” Islam has provided women economic and social protection. In the same way the right of protection from slander is also given to women. According to verse number 4 of Surah An-Nur, “Those who accuse chaste women of adultery and then do not bring four witnesses, lash them eighty lashes and never accept their testimony; these are the transgressors.” Legally women have the right, after marriage, to attach the name of the father or husband to their own name.

Education:

Article 10 of the convention provides men and women equal opportunities in every field for the acquisition of education. In the same way equal opportunities of physical education and sports will be given. In Islam the importance of and right to education for women is clear from this fact that Hazrat Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) was a famous student; according to Urwah bin Zubair he did not see a greater scholar than Hazrat Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) in Arab history in understanding the Quran, following the commandments, observing the law, literature, poetry and history. She also had knowledge of medicine and was an expert in law and inheritance too. She taught 88 scholars and is the narrator of 2219 ahadith. Proof of the scholarship of Hazrat Safiyyah (may Allah be pleased with her), Hazrat Umm Salamah (may Allah be pleased with her) and Hazrat Umm Sulaim (may Allah be pleased with her) also exists. The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) said that acquiring knowledge is obligatory on every Muslim man and woman. From this it is proved that acquiring education is the right of both men and women.

Profession and employment:

According to Article 11, party states will provide women equal opportunities of adopting the employment and profession of their own choice. In this respect no discrimination will be allowed against women. During pregnancy they will not be compelled to do any dangerous work, and in this respect women will have complete legal protection. In Islam women will be permitted to adopt employment provided it is within the sphere of the Shariah. In the Quran and Hadith there is no such mention that a woman should not be employed. If she herself does not feel the need, women cannot be compelled to adopt employment. The husband has not been bound to take anything from the wife’s lawful earnings. Whatever the woman earns during employment is her own income, and she cannot be compelled to spend it in the house …

… cannot be compelled to spend. However rich the wife may be, providing bread, clothes and house to the wife is the responsibility of the husband.

Marriage:

According to Article 16, states are bound to end all discrimination against women with respect to marriage and family relations. Equal opinion in marriage, choice of husband, permission to marry by one’s own will, equal responsibilities after marriage and the equal right to end the marital relationship, equal responsibilities with respect to children, equal rights with respect to waqf, ownership and administration: ensuring equal rights etc. is the responsibility of states.

Marrying is the right of women, and in marriage knowing the woman’s will is also her right. In volume seven of Sahih Bukhari, chapter 43, Hadith number 69, it is that “A woman whose father forced her to marry against her will went to the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions). The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) declared that marriage invalid.” According to Imam Ibn Hanbal, hadith 736 and 7396, it is narrated: “The best among Muslims are those who are good in character and conduct, and who treat their family and wives well.” Islam has given women as mothers a very sacred place. In Surah Bani Israel Allah Almighty says: “and be kind to parents.” According to verse 14 of Surah Luqman: “We have enjoined on man concerning his parents; his mother carried him, suffering hardship upon hardship, and his weaning is in two years.” From the Quran and Hadith it is proved that Paradise is under the feet of the mother. According to the sayings of the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions), three-quarters of love and affection is in the mother’s share and one quarter in the father’s share. As sisters too women have several rights.

Political rights:

According to Articles 7 and 8, ending discriminatory behaviour with women in the political and public field is the duty of states. They will have to be given the right to vote equal to men and the right to take part as candidates. The participation of women in policy-making will be ensured. Their participation in government and non-government institutions relating to political affairs will be ensured. Opportunities will be provided to women in settling the country’s international affairs. According to Article 3, states, including legislation, are bound to all such measures …
